x: In the 4 x 880 yds. we fielded a useful team, and with Frank Webb giving us the lead over the second stage, and Alec Ball keeping it, Tommy Scrimshaw just "sauntered" round for the last leg.
Included in the meeting were also three Club running handicaps. The 880 Yards was won by Alec Ball, with E.
Harry Shields also turned out in this race, and Alec Ball was our third man. They finished 3, 4, 5; but with Surrey scoring 1, 2, 6, we were beaten in the team race.
Since the last issue of the Gazette the undermentioned members have notified their call to the Services:— A.
Alec Ball, in the Navy, sends his regards to the lads, and hopes to be back with us after this spot of bother. Harry Churcher, now stationed at Bicester.
